name: mstack-write-specs
description: Turn an idea, feature, bug class or refactor into an approved, testable specification: grilling interview rounds that settle every decision, approaches before drafting, EARS requirements with SHALL and a scenario each, a quality checklist, an independent read, and explicit approval before any build. One skill for Claude Code and Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Interview, then write an approved, testable spec.
interface.longDescription: Settles every decision in numbered interview rounds with recommended answers, looks up facts instead of asking, compares approaches, and writes a spec whose requirements use EARS and SHALL with a GIVEN/WHEN/THEN scenario each. A quality checklist and an independent reader catch gaps, and nothing is built before the user approves the written file.
